tasks.short: Determine semiconductor process specifications and operation sequence from controlled work instructions.

steps.what: Locate the correct work order and current process instructions for this material lot
Study instructions, formulas and processing charts to determine specifications and operation sequence
Enter and check the selected specification and sequence references in the lot traveler
Save the checked lot traveler references

tasks.design: Configure a native lot-linked document view in {OPS_SYSTEM}/{DOCS} to reduce finding and revision navigation. The technician still studies the complete actual instructions and determines specifications and operation sequence, then enters and checks the actual traveler references before the separate existing save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Work orders and controlled instruction revisions may require separate navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native lot-document relations can expose the correct source package without generating a process recipe.
tasks.still_hard: Correct revision, material state and process interpretation remain critical.
tasks.human_edge: The technician interprets the actual work order against the material and approved process.
tasks.altitude: Less document navigation; no process engineering authority is gained.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: controlled manufacturing record systems can link lot work orders to instruction revisions.

assumptions: Boundary is specification and sequence determination through its traveler entry, not recipe execution or process redesign.

Planning produces lot ID, work-order ID and specified route; process engineering supplies controlled document IDs and revisions. The technician verifies the match in s1. Missing links require manual navigation, counted in retained time.
Study and actual traveler entry retain full effort. Shares are provisional; existing native links earn no new saving.
The existing entry accuracy check covers the separate save. Its 1 percent is schema granularity, not a measured click baseline.
research_questions: Does the native lot view expose the correct current and lot-applicable revisions?

incremental.description: Check lot-document link exceptions and revision routing

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete checked traveler specification and sequence references for the actual lot

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional navigation reduction: 15 units at 50 percent saves 7.5 points minus one upkeep = 6.5. Half eligible navigation gives 2.75. Actual study, determination, entry and save retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain actual semiconductor processing, production and inspection records and reports.

steps.what: Capture and verify actual lot processing events, production counts and inspection results
Assemble processing, production and inspection fields into the required report tables
Write actual processing deviations, inspection exceptions and the required explanatory notes
Check complete records and reports against actual lot evidence and required scope
File the checked final production information and report

tasks.design: Use a native {OPS_SYSTEM} report template first to assemble exact separately captured actual processing, production and inspection fields. Keep original capture, deviation explanations and complete record verification human; separately file the checked final report in {DOCS} without inferring pass status from missing data.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing actual records may be copied into recurring production report tables.
tasks.enabler_now: Native manufacturing report templates can reuse exact recorded fields without a drafting model.
tasks.still_hard: Actual deviations, missing inspections and corrections need source-level investigation.
tasks.human_edge: The technician distinguishes actual completed processing and inspection from planned values.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated table assembly; quality release authority does not change.

evidence.claim: Critical Manufacturing MES supports semiconductor defect capture and equipment data links, providing a native route for actual process records.

assumptions: Boundary is maintaining actual processing, production and inspection information through the final report; it does not perform inspections or release product.

The technician captures and verifies lot ID, operation, actual time, equipment ID, quantities, actual readings with units, inspection results, exception state and source references in s1. Equipment supplies actual readings and inspection work supplies actual results; s1 retains their association and checking effort.
Only exact present fields populate tables. Missing fields stay visibly missing and are completed manually before s4; planned values never stand in for actual results.
Shares and reduction are provisional and apply only where recurring table copying really exists. Existing reporting runtime earns no saving. The 1 percent filing action retains full effort.
research_questions: Can native reports reproduce required tables with exact source traceability and explicit missing values?

incremental.description: Maintain report field mappings and investigate failed source links

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final checked production report with actual lot evidence and exception notes

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional repeated factual table assembly saves 30 points minus two upkeep = 28. Half eligible tables gives 15 minus two = 13. Capture, actual explanations, complete checks and filing retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Start semiconductor processing cycles using the correct physical controls or commands.

steps.what: Check the actual lot, approved recipe and equipment readiness before starting
Set valves, switches or panel commands and check the final intended start configuration
Operate the checked start control to begin the semiconductor processing cycle
Observe actual cycle initiation and respond to an unsuccessful start
Enter and check the actual cycle start status in the lot record
Save the checked actual cycle start entry

tasks.design: Retain physical setup, actual readiness checking and the separate checked cycle-start action in {OTHER}, the equipment control panel. Inspect native recipe recall and actual start-status capture in {OPS_SYSTEM} first; this scenario already uses those functions, so the explicit actual entry and save offer no further established saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual equipment and material readiness cannot be established from a generated instruction.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing recipe and start logging functions already support the operator; no additional change is established.
tasks.still_hard: Physical valve state, actual material identity and unsuccessful starts require direct attention.
tasks.human_edge: The technician checks real readiness and responds to actual equipment behaviour.
tasks.altitude: No changed authority or time benefit established for starting this cycle.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: equipment panels and native recipe recall support cycle starts; existing machine runtime is not new human labour saving.

assumptions: Boundary is preparation, physical or panel start, observed response and actual lot start entry. No downstream monitoring or finished-product result is inferred.
Process engineering supplies the approved recipe; the technician checks actual lot and equipment in s1 and actual start in s4. There is no free structured readiness input.
The final configuration check is ordinary pre-start work, not added approval ceremony. The actual entry and its existing check are separated from the save before concluding zero.

Shares are provisional. Native recall and automatic timestamp display are already present in this scenario; actual operator verification and short entry retain full effort. Zero new upkeep because no mechanism is introduced. The two 1 percent actions are schema granularity.
unknowns: Whether any manual duplicate start entry exists
research_questions: Observe physical control and record boundaries before proposing a change.

incremental.description: No new mechanism or ongoing upkeep

approvals.approved_version: s2 checked exact start configuration for the actual lot recipe and equipment
s5 complete checked actual start entry based on observed response

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Actual readiness, physical setup, checked start, actual response observation and separated record entry and save all retain full effort. Existing panel and logging runtime earns no new saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inspect semiconductor equipment for leaks, diagnose faults and request repairs.

steps.what: Review current equipment instructions and relevant actual fault history
Inspect equipment for actual leaks and other malfunction symptoms
Diagnose the actual malfunction within technician limits and determine needed repair support
Write and check the repair request with actual symptoms, equipment and urgency
Send the checked repair request to the internal maintenance team
Write and check actual inspection findings and the repair request reference
Save the checked actual equipment inspection record

tasks.design: Configure a native equipment-history view in {OTHER}, the maintenance system, with controlled {DOCS} inspection links. Keep leak inspection, fault diagnosis, fresh request writing and actual inspection record writing human; the separate {HELPDESK} request send and {OPS_SYSTEM} save retain their existing effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: Equipment history and current inspection references may need separate searches.
tasks.enabler_now: Native equipment-related records can reduce navigation without diagnosing from incomplete symptoms.
tasks.still_hard: Actual leaks and malfunction causes require physical inspection and qualified interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The technician recognises real symptoms and the limit of their own diagnostic authority.
tasks.altitude: Less history navigation; maintenance authority remains unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native maintenance systems can display equipment-linked fault history and controlled document references.

assumptions: Boundary is inspecting, diagnosing and requesting repairs through the actual inspection record. Maintenance repair execution is not counted or represented as complete.

Existing maintenance activity produces dated history and engineering supplies current instructions. The technician matches equipment identity in s1; missing links require manual lookup. Actual symptom capture remains in s4 and s6.

Native forms and existing request routing are considered first; substantive actual symptom writing is not removed. Separate local inspection and request records are assumed only where both are actually required; do not create duplicate paperwork to claim a benefit.
Shares are provisional. Only history navigation changes. Existing request and record accuracy checks cover final versions; separate 1 percent actions are fully retained schema granularity.
unknowns: Whether request and lot inspection records are distinct actual requirements
research_questions: Does the equipment history view remove searching without adding duplicate inspection paperwork?

incremental.description: Check equipment-history links and obsolete instruction references

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete checked repair request with actual equipment symptoms urgency and maintenance recipient
s6 complete checked actual inspection record and submitted repair request reference

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional ten-unit history lookup at 50 percent saves five points minus 0.5 upkeep = 4.5. Half eligible lookup gives two. Physical inspection, diagnosis, actual written request and record, send and save retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less repeated record assembly and source navigation; process and quality authority remain unchanged.
skills_to_grow: Validate native report mappings against actual process records
Distinguish actual machine state from planned recipe state
role.ambitious_version: A technician who prepares reliable source-linked process records while retaining hands-on process judgement.
